**So that** the remaining batches run against a standard that has already been applied

## Notes
Superseded 2026-09-02, before delivery. Batching seven stories under one
story did not match the board's shape, so #251 was restructured to one story
per epic. The original criteria were never met and are not ticked.

Nothing was dropped: #255 to #261 moved to their epic's story, #253 and #254
to #311, #262 was closed as superseded.

This story records the decision only. The work it described lives on the
stories under #251, and the standard it was meant to establish lives in
